stories.title: Public consultation launched on new North Wales fire training centre

stories.title: Construction begins on Shotton church community hub conversion
stories.summary: Construction has started on the redevelopment of Rivertown United Reformed Church in Shotton into a community hub. Gareth Morris Construction Ltd, a contractor based in Pontfadog near Llangollen, has been appointed as main contractor for the project. Work began on site on Monday, 29 June. stories.title: M53 to have overnight closures for four months as part of £50m upgrade
stories.summary: Drivers are set to face disruption as a section of a major motorway will undergo months of overnight closures. National Highways are embarking on a major three-year series of works on the aging M53. The road, which runs through Wirral and Cheshire, will see £50m of investment to ensure it is fit for the future.
